rounds.title: Contrast next to each token
rounds.note: Each colour token row ends in its ratio on surface, surface-raised and surface-overlay (on-* on their fills), with the bar (>= 4.5 text, >= 3 non-text, exempt disabled) and a red mark below it. The old Text/On/Ratio list outside the sheet is gone. Finding: --surface-border is 1.2-1.6:1.
rounds.lost: r1 flagged --surface-border as missing 3:1; Q42 says it is decorative

a.note: Each token row ends in three ratio chips drawn on surface, surface-raised and surface-overlay (on-* tokens on their fills), with the bar it needs and a mark when it misses it. Replaces the separate ratio list that sat outside the sheet. Costs: subtle tokens get no chips (translucent on a raised surface needs compositing the helper lacks).
